title: fix: stop routine community token alerts
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Removes routine token-count and billing-arithmetic flags from community probes.
- Updates the monitor prompt to ignore old flags while preserving real protocol-failure alerts and requested diagnostics.
- Keeps probe usage for spend accounting and verifies inconsistent totals no longer produce alerts.

gist.headline: The alarm learned manners
gist.blurb: The community monitor stopped buzzing about routine token arithmetic. It still keeps an eye out for actual protocol trouble, because not every number needs a tiny emergency hat.
gist.summary: Community probes now ignore routine token-count and billing-arithmetic flags, while retaining protocol-failure alerts, requested diagnostics, and probe-based spend accounting.
gist.impact: Monitoring will stay focused on real protocol failures and requested diagnostics instead of producing alerts when usage totals are inconsistent.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a calm garden monitor keeper beside a cozy retro terminal: harmless token-count alert papers are being sorted into a compost bin while a single genuine protocol-warning flower remains clearly visible. The scene represents quieter, more useful monitoring without losing real diagnostics.
